about_the_game:
Dive into a dystopian world where cooperation is your only chance of survival.

🌆 Explore an Infinite dungeon

In Neon Dystopia, every run generates a unique maze of interconnected rooms. No two explorations are ever the same — the dungeon stretches endlessly, filled with secrets, traps, and hidden challenges in a retro-futuristic atmosphere.

👥 Multiplayer co-op

Gather your team and set off on an adventure with friends! With built-in multiplayer via Steam, you can play together without real limitations. Coordinate your moves, share resources, and survive in a hostile world where unity is strength.

⚡ Rogue-like gameplay

  • Procedural generation: Each dungeon is randomly generated with unique rooms, corridors, and challenges

  • Progression system: Manage your health, shield, and stamina to survive the dangers

  • Deadly traps: Dodge retractable spikes, crumbling floors, and other devious mechanisms

  • Vertical exploration: Climb higher through increasingly difficult levels

🎨 Retrowave aesthetic

Neon Dystopia immerses you in a pixel art universe where vibrant neon colors light up a dystopian world. Its 80s-inspired retrowave style blends nostalgia and modernity into a striking visual experience.

🔧 Key features

  • Co-op multiplayer: Team up with friends via Steam

  • Endless dungeons: Procedural exploration with no limits

  • Tactical combat: Face dangers and enemies with strategy

  • Room system: Discover and track your progression

  • Modern interface: A clear, intuitive UI for optimal gameplay

Are you ready to uncover the secrets of Neon Dystopia?

Assemble your team, prepare for the journey, and dive into an endless retro-futuristic world...
